A small, fast personal website about engineering, people and practical ideas.

The design

Condensed lettering, drawing-ink blue and a light canvas take their cues from technical drawings. The work is presented as three connected practices, with room for each story to breathe.

Type & imagery

Headlines use Barlow Condensed by Jeremy Tribby. Reading and interface text use Manrope by Mikhail Sharanda. Both are locally hosted under the SIL Open Font License.

The portrait is Samir’s graduation photograph, retained from his original website. Civil design and common-ground illustrations were created for this portfolio. They are conceptual illustrations, rather than client project drawings or photographs.

Privacy & accessibility

This site has no analytics, advertising, tracking cookies or remote AI service. Fonts and images are served with the website. Lab calculations run locally. Copying a calculation link shares the numeric inputs in its URL; review context is excluded.

Navigation supports a keyboard, motion follows your device preference, and core portfolio content is available without JavaScript. Lab calculations require JavaScript.

Acknowledgements

Research included Awwwards, Muzli and UI UX Showcase, alongside the portfolios of Dennis Snellenberg and Brittany Chiang. Their work informed the emphasis on identity, hierarchy and clear navigation. This site uses original layouts and assets.

Implementation guidance drew on Anthropic’s frontend-design skill and Vercel’s Web Interface Guidelines.
